article.title: Beneficiario con に
article.part: Partículas y relaciones — 助詞と関係
article.chapter: Objeto y partículas centrales: を/に/で/へ — 目的語と主要助詞：を／に／で／へ

claims.summary: The Japan Foundation’s Irodori Grammar Notes explain that V-てあげる presents an act done for another person considered to benefit, give 両親に、家を建ててあげるつもりです, mark the receiver with に, and warn that あげる may sound pushy or rude toward a superior.

locator.description: PDF, Lesson 18, point 3, p. 180: V-てあげる example and contrast, テ-form formation, に marking the receiver, and caution for supervisors/teachers.
